Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added Song Requests: listeners upload a song from their PC, you accept/decline from a new Requests tab
Added a Whitelist/Blacklist for who can send you song requests
Added a crossfader curve selector: Cut, Power (default), or Linear
